scope: Authenticated retained results, not reexecuted checks. Every queued record remains unreviewed. Batches are scheduling groups, not applicability decisions, completion percentages or later-chunk exemptions. The separate periphery, density and application obligations still apply.

batches.title: Local geometry and resistor/pad selectors
batches.next_action: Bind exact catalog operands to existing geometry or absence evidence; resolve URPM construction separately.

batches.title: Marked high-voltage geometry
batches.next_action: Bind catalog operands to the reviewed nominal contract, raw HV selectors and label census; preserve electrical tagging obligations.

batches.title: Coordinate grids and layer aliases
batches.next_action: Separate drawn vertices, text anchors and generated-mask purposes; resolve unit and metop alias meanings before accepting the existing diagnostics.

batches.title: Device identification and RF geometry
batches.next_action: Resolve each device selector and standard-cell exemption. RF map/Table H5 remain explicit dependencies; cell-name absence alone cannot resolve device recognition.

batches.title: Core context and generated implant masks
batches.next_action: Establish COREID and generated-mask construction/enclosure. Empty drawn masks are not evidence that their enclosed targets are absent.

batches.title: Module cut and selected boundary rules
batches.next_action: Define moduleCutAREA and q0/q1 subjects, then prove applicability or execute spacing/enclosure; an absent enclosing region is not sufficient.

batches.title: Frame, seal, scribe and alignment marks
batches.next_action: Establish explicit frame/die-cut, seal and alignment context, including exemptions. Do not substitute a block bounding box for chip boundaries.

batches.title: Pads, package geometry and ViaTop
batches.next_action: Resolve ViaTop and pad construction, then bind each required geometry/connectivity check or prove its selected subject absent.

batches.title: VPP, dummy diffusion and density
batches.next_action: Resolve VPP cell selection, dummy diffusion and density window/operand semantics; retain the separate wider density obligations beyond these catalog records.

batches.title: Connectivity, redundancy and chip labels
batches.next_action: Review chip-context records separately from block checks; bind physical graphs, labels, redundant contacts and interface regions to their exact scope.

batches.title: Routing blockages and boundary purposes
batches.next_action: Resolve Block/Routing operands and forbidden boundary purposes, including the distinct r/s records; do not inherit coverage from a shared name.
